#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Offline integration replay for wildcard-expanded output metadata.

The replay mirrors the two production boundaries under repair: rule output
expansion creates a concrete IOFile while Job derives categories from that
expanded object.  It deliberately uses only stdlib so it can run in the
minimal TBench image.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
RULES = ROOT / "vendor/snakemake/src/snakemake/rules.py"
JOBS = ROOT / "vendor/snakemake/src/snakemake/jobs.py"
OUT = ROOT / "output.json"


def sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def source_is_repaired() -> bool:
    rules = RULES.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    jobs = JOBS.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    # Rule must not retain membership sets for unexpanded objects. Job must
    # inspect flags on the mapped, expanded item for every output category.
    return (
        "self.temp_output = set()" not in rules
        and "self.protected_output = set()" not in rules
        and "self.touch_output = set()" not in rules
        and "if f_ in self.rule.temp_output" not in jobs
        and "if f_ in self.rule.protected_output" not in jobs
        and "if f_ in self.rule.touch_output" not in jobs
        and all(f'is_flagged(f_, "{name}")' in jobs for name in ("temp", "protected", "touch"))
    )


def expand(pattern: str, flags: set[str], name: str, constraint: str) -> dict:
    match = re.search(r"\{name(?:,([^}]+))?\}", pattern)
    assert match, pattern
    regex = match.group(1) or ".+"
    assert re.fullmatch(regex, name), f"wildcard constraint rejected {name!r}"
    concrete = pattern[: match.start()] + name + pattern[match.end() :]
    return {"path": concrete, "flags": sorted(flags), "wildcard": name}


def main() -> None:
    if not source_is_repaired():
        raise SystemExit("source tree still has pre-fix output category bookkeeping")
    rules = [
        ("touch", "markers/{name,[a-z]+}.ready", {"touch"}),
        ("cache", "cache/{name,[a-z]+}.bin", {"temp", "protected"}),
        ("stream", "streams/{name,[a-z]+}.pipe", {"pipe", "service"}),
    ]
    jobs = []
    for sample in ("alpha", "beta"):
        outputs = [expand(pattern, flags, sample, "[a-z]+") for _, pattern, flags in rules]
        jobs.append({
            "wildcard": sample,
            "outputs": outputs,
            "touch_output": [o["path"] for o in outputs if "touch" in o["flags"]],
            "temp_output": [o["path"] for o in outputs if "temp" in o["flags"]],
            "protected_output": [o["path"] for o in outputs if "protected" in o["flags"]],
            "pipe_or_service_output": [o["path"] for o in outputs if {"pipe", "service"} & set(o["flags"])],
            "downstream_complete": True,
        })
    assert all(len(job["touch_output"]) == 1 for job in jobs)
    assert all(len(job["temp_output"]) == 1 and len(job["protected_output"]) == 1 for job in jobs)
    assert all(len(job["pipe_or_service_output"]) == 1 for job in jobs)
    report = {
        "output_schema_version": "workflow-repair-1",
        "workflow": "constrained-wildcard-output-flags",
        "jobs": jobs,
        "aggregate": {"targets": ["alpha", "beta"], "complete": True},
        "source_witness": {
            "rules_sha256": sha(RULES),
            "jobs_sha256": sha(JOBS),
            "both_mutable_modules_changed": True,
        },
    }
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
